name: The Autonomous Stack — Public Digest
purpose: Compact machine-readable digest of the public repository, documentation, and Free Sample Agent.

maintenance.rule: Keep this digest synchronized with public-facing Markdown and material behavior changes.

product.positioning: Turnkey building blocks for autonomous AI agents.
product.public_repository_scope: Documentation plus the complete Free Sample Agent v1.0. Paid packs and production/server internals are excluded.
product.local_first: The free sample deterministic core runs locally without a cloud API. Optional LLM reasoning uses an already-installed supported CLI.

free_sample.name: Free Sample Agent v1.0
free_sample.requirements: Python >= 3.10; deterministic core uses Python stdlib only; systemd optional.
capabilities: JSON-file task queue with enqueue, run, and status operations
deterministic transforms: upper, lower, reverse, wordcount

sample_flow: optional BYO-LLM reasoning or deterministic transform
invariants: missing LLM CLI does not prevent deterministic operation

x402.status: The unauthenticated HTTP 402 challenge on paid pack endpoints was verified during the publication audit; the public repository does not claim an independently exercised full paid settlement flow.
